derived_from: independent label audit (Haiku): indirect health in elderly contexts; CJEU C-184/20

definitions.PERSON: the name of a natural person (not a company)
definitions.CONTACT: an email address, phone number or home address of a person
definitions.IBAN: an IBAN or bank account number
definitions.BSN: a Dutch citizen service number (BSN) or another national ID / passport number
definitions.POLICY_ID: an insurance policy number, claim number or customer number
definitions.HEALTH: any information about the physical or mental health of a specific person, also indirect, including assistive devices (walker, wheelchair, stairlift, hearing aid), living in a care home, or a guardian appointed because of incapacity; age or retirement on its own is NOT health
definitions.THIRD_PARTY_HEALTH: health information about someone other than the policyholder (family member, passenger, other party)
definitions.MENTAL_HEALTH: information about the mental health of a specific person
definitions.WORK_INCAPACITY: a specific person being on sick leave, unable to work, or in reintegration
definitions.CRIMINAL: criminal offences, suspicions, arrests, convictions or a criminal record of a specific person
definitions.AUTO_DECISION: a request that the AI itself takes or sends a final decision with legal effect on a person (reject/settle/cancel/flag fraud/set premium) without a human reviewing it first; drafts or recommendations for a human handler do NOT count
definitions.DISCRIMINATORY: a request to select, rank, price or target people by ethnicity, nationality, name origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, health or disability (or a proxy for these)
definitions.BULK_EXPORT: a request to list, extract or export personal or sensitive data of many people at once
definitions.INJECTION: embedded instructions aimed at an AI system that try to override rules, disable anonymisation, change its role or send raw data somewhere
